anchors.description: Long top edge of the white printed sheet in the foreground tray, measured between its visible top-left and top-right corners (same sheet).
anchors.visible_evidence: A flat white sheet with a centered header line and two dense text columns lies in the black tray close to the camera; its top edge runs from the visible upper-left corner (~x361,y383) to the upper-right corner (~x530,y372), and the two candidate corners bracket exactly that edge.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: The sheet is a printed two-column page (portrait), so the top edge is the short page edge: US Letter 8.5 in (0.2159 m) most likely in a NYU/US scene, A4 (0.210 m) possible; if the page were actually landscape-printed the top edge would be 0.279-0.297 m, hence the wide upper interval bound. Corner points sit near the sheet boundary where the black tray lip is adjacent, so a few pixels of depth bleed are possible.
